UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Represents the authenticated user's studio account profile created on sign-up or sign-in.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

displayName.description: Full name or studio owner name of the user.

email.description: Email address associated with the user's Google account.

studioRole.description: Role or title of the account holder (e.g., Lead Photographer, Studio Owner).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BusinessProfile.title: BusinessProfile
BusinessProfile.description: Represents a photography business or studio profile managed by the user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this business profile.

name.description: Display name of the photography business.

category.description: Specialty or studio category (e.g., Weddings, Portraits, Events, Commercial).

defaultPricePerPicture.description: Default unit price per picture for quick transaction entry.

monthlyTarget.description: Monthly revenue goal for target progress tracking.

accentColorHex.description: Hex color code for visual badge differentiation.

ClientProfile.title: ClientProfile
ClientProfile.description: Represents a photography client in the CRM directory for a specific business profile.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this client record.

businessId.description: The ID of the BusinessProfile this client belongs to.

phoneNumber.description: Client phone number used for CRM contact and accounting lookup.

email.description: Optional email address of the client.

notes.description: General client preferences, package notes, or shoot details.

ClientInteraction.title: ClientInteraction
ClientInteraction.description: Represents a timestamped CRM interaction log entry for a client.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this interaction log.

businessId.description: The ID of the BusinessProfile associated with this interaction.

clientId.description: The ID of the ClientProfile this interaction belongs to.

clientName.description: Name of the client at the time of logging.

interactionDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of when the interaction took place.

PhotoTransaction.title: PhotoTransaction
PhotoTransaction.description: Represents an accounting transaction recording picture count, unit price, customer phone, and payment method.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this transaction.

businessId.description: The ID of the BusinessProfile this transaction belongs to.

clientId.description: Optional ID of the linked ClientProfile (or empty string if unlinked).

customerPhone.description: Phone number of the customer for this transaction.

transactionDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds representing the transaction date.

yearMonth.description: YYYY-MM string used for monthly financial reporting.

pictureCount.description: Number of pictures included in this transaction.

totalAmount.description: Total earnings calculated from pictureCount * pricePerPicture.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used by the customer.

/users/{userId}/clients/{clientId}.description: User-scoped CRM client records associated with a business profile.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: User-scoped accounting transactions for photography shoots.
